# Gear Trains {#sec-gears}

## Ratios {#sec-gears-ratios}

A gear train's ratio is the product of its stage ratios. The sizing table in @tbl-widget-classes gives reference pitches, and @eq-sizing gives the identity. Unknown references such as @sec-does-not-exist pass through verbatim.
